senses.gloss: अव्रण a. Without wounds or scars or rents, unhurt, sound.
अव्रण + .{@-णम्@} One of the four diseases of the eye.

अव्रत्यम् [व्रताय हितम् यत्, न˚ त˚] Violation of religious
 duties, offence against the rule of an ascetic.

आव्रश्च् €6 P. To tear off, cut off; यो अस्याः कर्णावास्कुनोत्या स
 देवेषु वृश्चते Av. 12. 4. 6; tear in pieces, interrupt.

—1 Cutting or tearing off.
—2 The stump of a tree (Ved.).
आव्रस्कः Being torn off or tearing itself off (Ved.).
आव्रीडकः [आव्रीडानां विषयो देशः] A country inhabited by shameless people.
